newsitem.title: ITALY: Storm briefly closes Milan's Mapensa airport.
newsitem.headline: Storm briefly closes Milan's Mapensa airport.

text.p: A severe rain storm caused the temporary closure of Milan's Malpensa airport on Tuesday afternoon while strong winds caused delays to flights at the city's Linate airport, a spokesman for Milan airports told Reuters.
Malpensa, some 40 kms west of the city, was closed from approximately 1210 GMT to 1345 GMT and six flights were diverted to land at other airports.
One flight from Bologna was diverted to Bergamo, two flights from Cuba, one from Los Angeles and one from Tokyo were diverted to Turin, and a flight from Casablanca was diverted to Linate.

At Linate, just five kms east of Milan, strong cross winds from about 1400 GMT were causing severe delays to flights as the airport switched its number 37 runway from the usual south to north operation to north to south. The spokesman said the north to south direction was little used and had less radar equipment in operation than on the usual direction and so delays were inevitable.
